assumptions: Increase is recurring monthly spend, not a one-time payment.
Downside scenario assumes no incremental revenue and unchanged baseline operations.
Contribution margin, when supplied, is an unverified assumption, not measured campaign ROI.

perspectives.CEO: Check strategic fit, founder delivery capacity and opportunity cost; preserve an explicit cash reserve.
perspectives.CFO: Compare downside cash burn and break-even revenue; account for upcoming obligations before approval.
perspectives.CMO: Require channel-level acquisition cost, conversion, attribution and payback evidence; test before scaling.

payload.recommendation: Consider only a capped experiment after validating acquisition economics, cash obligations and founder capacity.

next_action.action: Collect channel economics and set an affordable experiment cap before seeking approval.
next_action.success_criterion: Observed incremental contribution covers incremental spend within the founder-approved payback window.
